messages:
liz_marketing: Quick kickoff: Lightweight Refapp Blitz. One-file repo + 12m screencast + short benchmark note + 45m community webinar. Target publish Tue 12:00 PT. Need owners for repo, tutorial, bench, landing, ops.

 tom_devrel: Ill own the repo + screencast. Plan: minimal Q&A bot demo using embeddings and streaming chunks. Keep run instructions to a single curl.

 arya_engineer: Bench volunteer. Two profiles: interactive (<=512) and long-run (>=2048). Will report p50/p95 and cost per 1k tokens. Need test prompts from Tom.

 mike_growth: Landing + signup funnel. Map signups to HubSpot list "Lightweight Refapp" and tag utm_campaign=refapp_blitz. CTA options: Run in Browser, Watch Screencast.

 tom_devrel: Pushed initial repo. Run snippet for hero try-it: `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d '{\"model\":\"open-lite\",\"prompt\":\"Summarize this...\"}'`

 ops-bot: Calendar slot reserved Tue 12:00. Staging preview: https://refapp-blitz-preview.redwood.dev (internal). Drafts due Mon EOD.

 arya_engineer: First bench numbers in sheet: interactive p50=52ms p95=200ms; long-run p50=240ms p95=780ms. Exported CSV of prompts+responses to shared drive.

 liz_marketing: Owners: repo+tuto Tom; bench writeup Arya + Liz; landing+forms Mike; ops runbook Ops. Publish Tue 12:00 PT, social blast Wed 09:00 PT. Drop preview links and assets in thread before Mon EOD.

 tom_devrel: Added short arch diagram and a 6-step demo script to repo README. Will record screencast tomorrow morning.

 mike_growth: Landing copy in Figma. Wiring HubSpot webhook -> SFDC. Email + X + Dev Forum planned.

 liz_marketing: :rocket: Thanks team. If anyone hits blockers ping here and well reassign.
